title: ZR snapshot table-payload tamper-evidence (DB-276, Option A): additive table_digest_sha256 over the canonical JSON of each capture's table payload, verified by the loader snapshots.py; the three payload shapes (table.rows, tables, table.row_groups) documented in RULES_ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE.md; 37 canonical table-bearing snapshots gain the field (glob-derived, incl. the sweep-missed zr-22-131) and the 37 bundled copies are re-synced byte-identical; no existing content_digest or citation digest moves.
objective: Behaviour-identical for every consumer that reads the payload today; the numbers do NOT change (the sweep confirmed zr-23-22/zr-23-432 already carry the full R6B numbers). (1) services/api/app/rules/snapshots.py load_snapshot_file: after the UNCHANGED content_digest_sha256==sha256(verbatim_excerpt) check, detect a table payload — a 'table' dict with 'rows' or 'row_groups', XOR a 'tables' list (fail closed if both). When a payload exists, require a 'table_digest_sha256' field and verify it equals sha256 of the canonical JSON of the payload (json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8')), computed over the PARSED object so re-indentation never breaks it; raise SnapshotError on mismatch, on payload-without-digest, and on digest-without-payload. Snapshots with no payload are unaffected. (2) Add table_digest_sha256 to each of the 37 table-bearing canonical files under docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ (set derived by glob over 'table'/'tables', NEVER hard-coded 36 — the sweep omitted zr-22-131) and re-sync the 37 bundled copies under services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1/ with sync_zr_snapshots.py; content_digest_sha256 is unchanged on every file so no rule/reference/register citation digest (943b65f9.../9fab7be8...) moves. (3) Document the three payload shapes and the new field in docs/RULES_ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE.md section 5 (there is no separate snapshot JSON-schema file). row_groups normalisation in the reference-case checker is NOT needed (no table_assertion targets zr-24-522 today) and is deferred. This task changes no property fact, rule applicability, calculation, result or certainty label, so no NB evidence-record revision and no zoning-rule-review register entry are required (D-093-R037 / principle 20 not triggered).
business_reason: return-sweep-capture-tables.md (sizing the M5-T185 G3 finding): the governing R6B FARs/heights live in a sibling table/tables/row_groups field that no digest signs, while the digest-pinned verbatim_excerpt holds only a '[table - see structured table field]' placeholder. A silent edit to a table value breaks no content_digest and is caught only if a reference case happens to assert that exact field. This closes the tamper-evidence gap additively, with one shape documented and a mutation test.
outputs: the 37 table-bearing snapshot files under docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ and their bundled copies

acceptance_scenarios.then: exactly 37 files (18 table.rows + 18 tables + 1 table.row_groups, including zr-22-131) gain table_digest_sha256; a test asserts the digest-bearing set == the glob set so the count is derived, never hard-coded, and zr-22-131 is not missed again

acceptance_scenarios.given: a table-bearing snapshot with a correct table_digest_sha256
acceptance_scenarios.then: it loads; content_digest_sha256 (over verbatim_excerpt) is unchanged and still verified

acceptance_scenarios.given: a tmp snapshot with a table payload + correct digest
acceptance_scenarios.when: one table value is changed without updating table_digest_sha256
acceptance_scenarios.then: load_snapshot_file raises SnapshotError (mutation proof: the number is now signed)

acceptance_scenarios.then: each raises SnapshotError (fail closed, both directions)
it loads unchanged; no digest required
both pass — the 37 bundled copies are byte-identical to canonical and membership matches
they stay green (the numbers and content_digest are unchanged; the new field is additive)
table.rows, tables and table.row_groups and the table_digest_sha256 field are documented; no separate JSON-schema file exists to change
both pass; no NB record changes (no fact/label change) and snapshots.py crosses no modularity threshold

acceptance_scenarios.given: the evidence record NB-06, whose evidence E10 pins zr-23-432.snapshot.json by its whole-file LF sha256 (37c1414c... before this task)
acceptance_scenarios.when: the signed snapshot (ae06010e... after this task) is in place
acceptance_scenarios.then: NB-06 takes its next revision with E10's saved-copy hash re-pinned to the signed file's LF sha256 and a dependency assessment saying the file gained only its table digest (no captured text, value or reading changed); its code identity and every reading stay as they are; nothing is labelled Verified; research_record_check.py --check passes; the README's index cell for NB-06 follows only if its format requires the revision number

risks: RISK B1 (count): the sweep/brief say 36; the true table-bearing count at 0463ec78 is 37 (zr-22-131, a 'tables' payload, was omitted). The builder MUST derive the set by glob over 'table'/'tables' and let S1 pin the set; a hard-coded 36 silently leaves zr-22-131 unsigned.

RISK B2 (no digest moves): the new field is a sibling to verbatim_excerpt; content_digest_sha256 is computed over the excerpt only and must stay byte-identical on every file, so the ~40 rule/reference-case/register pins do not move. A test asserts content_digest_sha256 is unchanged for zr-23-22/zr-23-432.

RISK B3 (canonicalization): the digest is over the PARSED payload with sort_keys+compact separators, not raw file bytes, so re-indenting a snapshot JSON never breaks it; mutual-exclusivity of table vs tables is enforced (none has both today).

RISK B4 (scope boundary): no NB evidence-record, no zoning-rule-review register, no reference_cases edit, no rule/fixture change — the task adds integrity metadata only. Keeping those forbidden also keeps zero file overlap with spec-M5-T172 (which owns NB-04/NB-06/NB-01, the register, reference cases and the benchmark).
RISK B5 (ownership): new test lives directly under the owned tests/rules folder (no new test subfolder, per the placeholder-ownership rule) and builds fixtures in tmp_path at runtime.
path_notes: snapshots.py and sync_zr_snapshots.py are NOT NB-pinned (checked at 0463ec78). allowed_paths lists the 37 table-bearing canonical files and their 37 bundled copies explicitly (derived by glob over table/tables at the contract base); the non-table snapshots stay byte-identical. In-regime: at the seam the orchestrator appends the task to applicability.task_ids of D-093-R052/R043/R051 with a directive_registry digest resync + audit_log entry in the SAME commit, runs reg.evaluate_task_refs before claim (applicable==cited), appends the task to manifest.affected_tasks with a PROVISIONAL task_verifications row, and seeds the new test file + producer report before G0. Confirm no in-flight owner of docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1 or app/_zr_snapshots/v1 before claim. Replace the placeholder id M3-T013 with the ledger-assigned id and update the producer-report path + seed + g0.
